entries.title: Psalms 30:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David: dedication-song of the house.>> I will extol thee, Jehovah; for thou hast delivered me, and hast not made mine enemies to rejoice over me.

entries.title: Psalms 30:2
segments: Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

entries.title: Psalms 30:3
segments: Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol, thou hast quickened me from among those that go down to the pit.

entries.title: Psalms 30:4
segments: Sing psalms unto Jehovah, ye saints of his, and give thanks in remembrance of his holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 30:5
segments: For a moment [is passed] in his anger, a life in his favour; at even weeping cometh for the night, and at morn there is rejoicing.

entries.title: Psalms 30:6
segments: ¶As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 30:7
segments: Jehovah, by thy favour thou hadst made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 30:8
segments: I called to thee, Jehovah, and unto the Lord did I make supplication:

entries.title: Psalms 30:9
segments: What profit is there in my blood, in my going down to the pit? shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

entries.title: Psalms 30:10
segments: Hear, O Jehovah, and be gracious unto me; Jehovah, be my helper.

entries.title: Psalms 30:11
segments: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

entries.title: Psalms 30:12
segments: That [my] glory may sing psalms of thee, and not be silent. Jehovah my God, I will praise thee for ever.
